name: Villarcayo de Merindad de Castilla la Vieja (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally red over yellow with a blue wavy hoist stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villarcayo (a castle on red with the motto HEROICA MUY NOBLE MUY LEAL FIDELÍSIMA).
history: Municipal flag of Villarcayo de Merindad de Castilla la Vieja; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villarcayo arms — castle on red with motto
